item.description: Thousands of anti-fascist protesters took to the streets of Orléans on Saturday to demonstrate against a congress held by Marine Le Pen’s far-right National Rally party. The protest came amid renewed nationwide demonstrations over the cost of living, a week after rallies descended into street violence.
